title: Second moment on the sign cube
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb F_2$, and view it as a function on the sign cube through the coordinatewise bijection between $\mathbb F_2$ and $\{\pm1\}$. The square of its uniform $L^2$ norm on the sign cube equals the uniform average of $f(x)^2$ over the binary cube.
hypotheses_covered: f is a real-valued function on the n-dimensional F₂ cube
